verdict: key consistent: 70 signs for 73 letters (two lam-alif signs, the hamza of عطاء not written), 17 groups = 17 words; exactly one letter per shape and one shape per letter (29 shapes, lam-alif its own sign S19); needs the corrected plaintext (5 changes)
notes: Rows: 10v segmenter lines 1-6 (record's 1-6). Measured 12+14+13+13+11+7 = 70 signs (record 73; overlay figure 71) and 17 dividers (record 16; the last row ends with one). The record's note 'lam-alif is one letter' (10r l.13) is borne out: صلات and ملاحظ each have one sign S19 for لا. Record errors, from the cipher: (1) the enciphered text is 17 words and ends with متفضل (S6 S20 S15 S29 S8, the م ت ف ل as elsewhere, ض = S29 as in فاضل): 'ولعمري انه هو كذلك' (10v l.9) is the compiler's own comment, not part of the plaintext; the interlinear word over l.9 is this متفضل; (2) يحسن is محسن (first sign S6 = م as in جمال, متغافل, ملاحظ); (3) the cipher has an extra word متغافل after محسن (6 signs; غ S24 as in للغريب): the interlinear 'فل' over l.8 belongs to it; (4) معاز is معان (last sign S23 = ن as in محسن); (5) للعيوب is للغريب (S8 S8 S24 S14 S3 S1: ر S14 and ي S3 as in شريفة / كثير, ب S1 as in بديع). Corrected plaintext: بديع جمال ذو خصال شريفة كثير صلات محسن متغافل / فقيه معان للغريب ملاحظ جزيل عطاء فاضل متفضل. With it every group fits; the only gap is the hamza of عطاء (not written). The plaintext should therefore be marked answered (it was 'partial' because the praise text was doubtful). Built with keytool_lafix.py (keytool.py with the lam-alif check fixed: it compared every letter of a two-letter token with the same stream position).
